evidence.claim: Specializes in automatic electrical panel protection systems engineered to detect and extinguish fires at the source within seconds for switchgear and server racks.
Supplies a heavy-capacity 75 Kg CO2-based Dry Chemical Trolley unit designed for rapid high-volume fire suppression in oil refineries and airport runways.
Scope of manufacturing covers a full range of portable and trolley extinguishers, electrical panel suppression lines, and water-foam based equipment.
Fabricates a comprehensive fire hydrant system catalog featuring 18 distinct accessories across 7 component categories including single and double head landing valves.
Developed a specialized line of CAFS (Compressed Air Foam System) Water Mist Fire Extinguishers available in both backpack and trolley system formats.
Broadened industrial engineering capabilities in 2026 by entering the fire tender manufacturing sector and successfully delivering its first product batch.
Executes all corporate assembly and strict individual product inspections through an in-house testing facility at its Kundli Industrial Estate plant.
Scaled domestic infrastructure assets by initiating construction on an expanded 40,000 square foot manufacturing facility in Sonipat, Haryana.
Product range complies with core Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) regulatory frameworks including IS 15683, IS 2878, and IS 2190 guidelines.
Secured international qualification benchmarks via European Conformity (CE) certification alongside official supply empanelment with the Central Public Works Department.
